Cell F's strong interpretive claim that 'the delta_PMNS chain terminates -- no prediction exists' is a summary conclusion about the framework's broader physics program, not itself a computed quantity; the arc's own residual note ('any forced CP-like fact must live where the acting group is smaller') shows the negative claim covers only the bare 3-form level, so the flat 'terminates' phrasing in the synthesis document slightly overstates the narrower computed result (single-GL(5,K)-orbit / explicit descent datum for Y).
